# `token.aug`

<a id="symbol-token"></a>
## `token` · [source](token.aug#L12)

A real OAuth token endpoint. Exact client/redirect binding, S256 PKCE, expiry and one-use codes are enforced. Errors use OAuth JSON. The caller supplies `http` as `HttpRequest` from HTTP request. Dependency injection supplies `crypto` as [`Crypto`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto), `clock` as [`Clock`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock), `keys` as [`SigningKeys`](../common/keys.aug.md#symbol-SigningKeys), `codes` as [`ExpiringStore<AuthorizationCode>`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore), and `access` as [`ExpiringStore<AccessGrant>`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore). The result is `HttpResponse<Json>`. It can use [`crypto.sha256`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.sha256), [`crypto.equal`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.equal), [`crypto.random`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.random), [`crypto.signRsa`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.signRsa), [`clock.now`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock.now), [`keys.provider`](../common/keys.aug.md#symbol-SigningKeys.provider), [`codes.take`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.take), and [`access.put`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.put). It can fail with `CryptoError`, `TimeError`, `KeyError`, `JwtError`, `StoreFull`, and `HttpError`.

This handles `POST` requests at `/provider/token`. Use status 200 when the handler returns a body; a returned HttpResponse can set its own status. An unhandled request failure returns status 500 and cancels its request tasks. For declared failures, `CryptoError` returns status 503, `TimeError` returns status 503, and [`StoreFull`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-StoreFull) returns status 503. It sets `config` to the value from [`settings`](../common/settings.aug.md#symbol-settings).

It tries the following steps. It sets `form` to the value from `form` on `http` with type arguments [`TokenForm`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-TokenForm). If `form.grant_type` does not equal `"authorization_code"`, it returns the value from [`_oauthError`](token.aug.md#symbol-_oauthError) (`code` set to `"unsupported_grant_type"` and `description` set to `"Only authorization_code is supported."`). If `form.client_id` does not equal `config.clientId`, it returns the value from [`_oauthError`](token.aug.md#symbol-_oauthError) (`code` set to `"invalid_client"` and `description` set to `"The registered client is required."`).

If not (the value from `isToken` on `form.code` (`min` set to `43` and `max` set to `43`)) or not (the value from `isToken` on `form.code_verifier` (`min` set to `43` and `max` set to `128`)), it returns the value from [`_oauthError`](token.aug.md#symbol-_oauthError) (`code` set to `"invalid_grant"` and `description` set to `"The authorization grant is invalid."`). It sets `now` to the value from [`Clock.now`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/time/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Clock.now) on `clock`.

Select the first matching case for the value from [`ExpiringStore.take`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.take) on `codes` (`key` set to `form.code` and `now`). If the selected value is null, it returns the value from [`_oauthError`](token.aug.md#symbol-_oauthError) (`code` set to `"invalid_grant"` and `description` set to `"The authorization grant is invalid."`).

If the selected value is not null, it names it `grant` and follows these steps. It sets `challenge` to the unpadded URL-safe base64 encoding of the value from [`Crypto.sha256`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.sha256) on `crypto` (`input` set to the UTF-8 bytes of `form.code_verifier`).

If `grant.clientId` does not equal `form.client_id` or `grant.redirectUri` does not equal `form.redirect_uri` or not (the value from [`Crypto.equal`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.equal) on `crypto` (`left` set to the UTF-8 bytes of `challenge` and `right` set to the UTF-8 bytes of `grant.challenge`)), it returns the value from [`_oauthError`](token.aug.md#symbol-_oauthError) (`code` set to `"invalid_grant"` and `description` set to `"The authorization grant is invalid."`).

It sets `claims` to a new [`IdClaims`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-IdClaims) (`iss` set to `config.issuer`, `sub` set to `grant.subject`, `aud` set to `grant.clientId`, `exp` set to `now` plus `300`, `iat` set to `now`, `nonce` set to `grant.nonce`, and `name` set to `grant.name`). It sets `idToken` to the value from [`signJwt`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/jose.aug.md#symbol-signJwt) (`key` set to the value from [`SigningKeys.provider`](../common/keys.aug.md#symbol-SigningKeys.provider) on `keys`, `claims` set to a new `Json` (`value` set to `claims`), `kid` set to `"provider-1"`, and `tokenType` set to `"JWT"`) using `crypto`.

It sets `accessToken` to the unpadded URL-safe base64 encoding of the value from [`Crypto.random`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/crypto/contracts.aug.md#symbol-Crypto.random) on `crypto` (`size` set to `32`). It sets `value` to a new [`AccessGrant`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-AccessGrant) (`subject` set to `grant.subject`, `name` set to `grant.name`, and `expires` set to `now` plus `300`). It calls [`ExpiringStore.put`](../.aug-spec/august/0.19.0/memory/store.aug.md#symbol-ExpiringStore.put) on `access` (`key` set to `accessToken`, `value`, `expires` set to `value.expires`, and `now`).

It sets `body` to a new [`TokenResponse`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-TokenResponse) (`token_type` set to `"Bearer"`, `access_token` set to `accessToken`, `id_token` set to `idToken`, `expires_in` set to `300`, and `scope` set to `"openid profile"`). It returns a new `HttpResponse` (`body` set to a new `Json` (`value` set to `body`) and `headers` set to the value from [`securityHeaders`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-securityHeaders)). If this attempt raises `HttpError`, it catches it as `error` and returns the value from [`_oauthError`](token.aug.md#symbol-_oauthError) (`code` set to `"invalid_request"` and `description` set to `"Submit the required URL-encoded token fields once each."`).

## `_oauthError` · [source](token.aug#L8)

Private to its defining scope. The caller supplies `code` and `description` as `string`. The result is `HttpResponse<Json>`. It can fail with `HttpError`. It returns a new `HttpResponse` (`body` set to a new `Json` (`value` set to a new [`OAuthError`](contracts.aug.md#symbol-OAuthError) (`error` set to `code` and `error_description` set to `description`)), `status` set to `400`, and `headers` set to the value from [`securityHeaders`](../common/headers.aug.md#symbol-securityHeaders)).

## Built-ins · [reference](https://greenpandastudios.github.io/augscript/language-constructs)

`Bytes.base64url`: Encode immutable bytes as unpadded RFC 4648 URL-safe base64. `HttpRequest.form`: Decode a form record inside a handler so protocol-specific error responses can be returned. `string.bytes`: Encode this string as immutable UTF-8 bytes. `string.isToken`: Require an ASCII RFC 3986 unreserved token with a bounded length.
